hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '/deps/'; then echo 'BLOCK: deps/ contains vendored C source — do not modify' >&2; exit 2; fi
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$file_path" ] && echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.zig$'; then zig fmt "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; fi
